subject: Dedicated capacity safeguard checkpoint - QuantumMesh deal
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity safeguard request - QuantumMesh

Team —

QuantumMesh (deal QM-2026-145) is moving to final legal this week and has signals they want a Dedicated deployment starting Feb 10. Sales estimate: sustained ~50 RPS with spikes to ~120 RPS for 10–20 minute windows during evaluation; average request ~200 tokens. Customer expects 99.9% availability and <120ms median token latency for their critical path.

Can infra please: 
- Check current and near-term availability in us-west for GPU SKUs that meet this profile (H100-80 or 4x A100-80 equivalence).
- Provide a recommended sizing (nodes + GPU count) and a fallback lower-SKU option.
- Place a provisional capacity hold through 2027-01-31 for the recommended set if inventory exists (we can cancel if deal dissolves).

We need a reservation id to reference in the mutual action plan and to show the execs that we have inventory secured for their go-live. If you need a quick call, I can hop on.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/QM-2026-145

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity safeguard request - QuantumMesh

Aditya —

Quick inventory check attached (capacity-availability-sheet.csv). Short answer: we have a limited pool of H100-class capacity in us-west that can satisfy a 2-cluster deployment (prod + canary) at the sizing you called out. Rough recommendation:

- Prod: 2 nodes x 2 H100-80GB (8 GPUs total effective for batch-concurrency)
- Canary: 1 node x 1 H100-80GB
- Fallback: 4x A100-80GB spread across nodes (higher ops overhead but doable)

We can place a provisional hold (reservation RM-7521) for the above configuration through 2027-01-31. Notes:
- There are two competing holds for late-Jan already; this would be a soft hold (no financial commit) unless Sales requests a paid reservation.
- If Legal/Finance require a firm SLA or capacity escrow, we need procurement approval and a signed commitment.

I created an infra ticket to track: INFRA-2894. Attaching the availability sheet.

-Markus

Attachment: capacity-availability-sheet.csv (stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sana Riaz <sana@quantummesh.ai>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@quantummesh.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity safeguard request - QuantumMesh

Sana / Amelia —

Thanks for the productive call earlier. To align expectations with infra: could you confirm a couple quick items so we can lock a provisional capacity hold on our side?

1) Expected steady-state RPS and peak spike RPS (you mentioned ~50 steady, confirm).
2) Average and 95th-percentile sequence/token length for your typical requests.
3) Desired go-live window (you said mid-Feb but please confirm a firm earliest date).
4) Any constraints on region (us-west is our recommended default if you want lowest latency to your users).

If you can reply with those details today we’ll place a provisional hold and send over the mutual action plan with the reservation reference.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Sana Riaz <sana@quantummesh.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Park <amelia.park@quantummesh.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity safeguard request - QuantumMesh

Aditya —

Sorry for the late reply — holiday backlog. Confirming numbers:
- Steady-state: 40–60 RPS (most traffic around 50)
- Peak evaluation spikes: up to ~120 RPS for short bursts (10–30 minutes)
- Average tokens per request: ~200; 95th percentile ~560
- Target go-live: Feb 10, 2027 (we can shift by a week if needed)

We absolutely need SOC 2 evidence and a simple procurement checklist for our security team (they asked about audit logs and data retention). Procurement will aim to issue an initial PO by Jan 28 if legal clears.

Thanks,
Sana Riaz
Head of ML Ops, QuantumMesh
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity safeguard request - QuantumMesh

Aditya / team —

Confirmed: provisional hold placed under reservation RM-7521 for the configuration Markus recommended (Prod: 2x2 H100 nodes; Canary: 1x1 H100). Hold expiration: 2027-01-31 23:59 PST unless Sales requests conversion to a paid reserve.

Attachments: capacity-hold-form.pdf, reservation-statement.pdf (stubs).
Internal tracking: INFRA-2894 (Jira).

Next steps for Sales: 
- Ask Legal to prioritize the redline for the MSA; procurement expects a PO by 2027-01-28.
- If customer confirms go-live Feb 10, convert hold to paid reservation and notify infra to finalize hardware allocation.

Cost estimate for proposed config (monthly): ~$XXk — final number subject to SKU mix and any discounts (I included a line in the reservation-statement).

I’ll keep the hold active and will escalate if competing commitments appear.

Lauren Bishop
Head, Capacity Planning & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
